fields.Name: T202 - System Diagnostics Section Tab Navigation
fields.Description: Exercises the mj-tab-nav ActiveKey/TabChange wiring (diagnosticsTabs / onSectionTabChange) and the @if activeSection section-switching — the dashboard's primary L2 navigation, distinct from merely reaching the dashboard.

InputDefinition.goal: You are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo and switch to the Admin application, then open the 'Monitoring' section and select System Diagnostics. The page shows a horizontal section tab bar (Engine Registry / Redundant / Performance / Cache). Click through each of the four section tabs in turn and confirm the main panel body swaps to that section's distinct content. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away. Seeing each of the four section panels render as you click its tab is success.

judgeValidationCriteria: The System Diagnostics section tab bar renders with tabs for Engine Registry, Redundant, Performance, and Cache
Clicking each tab swaps the panel body to that section's distinct heading/content (e.g. 'Registered Engines', 'Redundant Entity Loading', 'Performance Telemetry', 'Local Cache')
The active tab is visually indicated as selected
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
